title: troia-ics: Provocation Testing for Dormant Supply-Chain Triggers in Industrial Control Systems — code and dataset
description: Code, container definitions, and the full experimental record accompanying the IEEE Access manuscript 'Pre-Deployment Provocation of Dormant Supply-Chain Triggers in Industrial Control Systems'. The record covers all 144 runs reported in the article: 40 main-matrix runs (baseline, malformed, mutate, replay; ten iterations each) and 104 binary-separation runs across three trigger classes (Class 1 data-conditioned, n=20 per arm; Class 2 sequence-conditioned and Class 3 environment-conditioned, n=16 per arm), each as per-sample JSONL streams plus per-channel summary JSON. Also included: the OpenPLC v3 program with the hidden contextual trigger, three observability collectors feeding four measurement channels, the Isolation Forest reference detector, the windowed 2-sigma and 3-sigma rule baselines, the ablation / cross-validation / seed-sensitivity / ROC-sweep analysis pipeline, the pre-registration document with its 2026-05-19 amendment, and all aggregated CSV and JSON summaries. Packet captures are not redistributed; the protocol-channel features derived from them are.
